# RCK — Outcome Partners

> Partner-led M&A transformation advisory and interim execution. RCK works on a 40/60 fee model: 40% of the fee is fixed, 60% is earned only when outcomes are independently verified in the client's general ledger. Seven named partners; three to four concurrent engagements each; 85%+ of engagements hit 90%+ of target outcomes. Offices in London and Barcelona.

## Core offer
- [The 40/60 fee model](https://www.rckpm.es/approach/40-60-fee-model): 40% fixed + 60% outcome-at-risk, verified in the general ledger with CFO or independent auditor sign-off.
- [Transformation Outcomes](https://www.rckpm.es/services/transformation-outcomes): post-merger integration, cost transformation, carve-outs and revenue synergy on the 40/60 model.
- [Interim Leadership & CxO Bench](https://www.rckpm.es/services/interim-management): pre-vetted interim CFO, COO and CIO, 48-hour identification, Week 1 deployment, published £8K–£25K/month all-in pricing.
- [TRANSFORM+ platform](https://www.rckpm.es/products/transform-plus): strategy-to-value execution with a verifiable audit trail.

## Why RCK
- [Why partner-led beats matrix](https://www.rckpm.es/about/partner-led-model): named partners own the result; smaller firms are faster because there are fewer layers between problem and decision.
- [Why PMI + interim should be integrated](https://www.rckpm.es/services/integrated-interim): one firm, one accountability structure, no coordination seam.
- [Founder-built playbooks](https://www.rckpm.es/about/founder-built-playbooks): playbooks written by operators who executed them, not consultant templates.
- [The partners](https://www.rckpm.es/about/team)
- [Case studies](https://www.rckpm.es/case-studies): representative, anonymised, independently verified engagements.
